NEW DELHI: Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi on Wednesday accused Aam Aadmi Party of "crushing those who question" the Punjab government after a man died by suicide following alleged pressure to apologise for publicly questioning the state's finance minister over the drug menace in the state.In a social media post on X, Rahul said Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann should immediately demand his minister Harpal Singh Cheema's resignation and ensure an independent and impartial investigation."A dangerous pattern is emerging in Punjab's AAP government - if you question government failures, the response will come in the form of threats and torture," Rahul said."Gulzar Singh ji, from the Dalit community, who had to watch his son fall victim to drugs, asked the finance minister just this much: why has the government failed so miserably in stopping the drug trade? For just this, he was tortured and humiliated so much, pressured so intensely to apologise, that he consumed poison. Wandering from one hospital to another, without access to treatment, he ultimately lost the battle for his life," he added.He said the government's job is to answer to the people, "not to crush those who ask questions"."Last week, I also spoke with a young Mohanjeet Singh, who was tortured for protesting against chief minister Bhagwant Mann," Rahul said."The government's job is to answer to the people, not to crush those who ask questions.May Gulzar Singh ji's family get justice as soon as possible. The chief minister should immediately demand the finance minister's resignation and ensure an independent and impartial investigation, with his name registered in the FIR," he added.A controversy erupted after a 47-year-old man, Gulzar Singh, from Sangrur allegedly died by suicide, with his family claiming that he was asked to apologise and subjected to casteist slurs for questioning finance minister Harpal Singh Cheema over the "unabated" supply of 'chitta' in his area at an event on September 6.Singh died on Monday night after allegedly consuming poison, his family members said.A purported video of Gulzar's last moments surfaced in which he spoke about questioning the finance minister, prompting opposition parties to demand the resignations of Cheema as well as Mann.Punjab Police set up a special investigation team (SIT), led by an officer of additional director general of police rank, in connection with the suicide incident.Following a complaint by Gulzar's family, five villagers - Baljit Singh, Sukhdev Singh, Vicky Singh, Gona Singh and Baljinder Kaur - have been booked under Section 108 (abetment of suicide) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and relevant sections of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, according to the FIR.
Article Summary: Rahul Gandhi accuses Aam Aadmi Party of "crushing those who question" Punjab government. A man died by suicide following alleged pressure to apologise for publicly questioning the state's finance minister over the drug menace in the state. Rahul said Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann should immediately demand his minister Harpal Singh Cheema's resignation.

Article Title: 'Why bring BJP into this?' Rijiju slams Rahul for targeting Shah over Manipuri musician's murder
Article Text:

NEW DELHI: Union minister Kiren Rijiju on Tuesday slammed Lok Sabha leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi for "politicising" the killing of Manipuri musician C Vikram Singh in Delhi, saying that the focus should be on immediate action.While talking to reporters, Rijiju said that Rahul should not bring BJP into the issue and said that Delhi Police takes immediate action whenever an incident involving people from the North East occurs."This is not the time for politics. I keep asking why Rahul Gandhi brings the BJP into this? When an incident occurs—a tragedy resulting in someone's death—the focus should be on immediate action. This is not a matter for politics," Rijiju said."The North East Special Police Cell established within the Delhi Police remains in constant contact, ensuring immediate action in the event of any incident. Things are no longer as they used to be; we have put a system in place to take swift measures. Consequently, whenever an incident involving people from the North East occurs in Delhi, immediate action is taken," he added.This comes after Rahul condemned the death of Manipuri musician Chongtham Vikram Singh, who was allegedly assaulted by a group of men and questioned Union home minister Amit Shah and Delhi Police over what they were doing to stop the "growing lawlessness" against people from the Northeast in Delhi."Chongtham Vikram Singh ji, a renowned musician from Manipur, went downstairs to ask some men to lower the noise outside his home. He was beaten to death for it. A father, killed outside his own home, in his own country's capital. After many such incidents, every Northeast family in Delhi is asking the same question today - are we safe here?" the Congress leader said."What are Shah's MHA and Delhi Police doing to stop this growing lawlessness, especially against people from the Northeast? There must be a swift investigation, and the culprits must be brought to justice. My condolences to Vikram ji's family," he added.The 54-year-old Manipuri music teacher allegedly died after being assaulted by a group of men in Kilokari Village, in Delhi’s Ashram area, following a dispute over noise and nuisance outside his residence.According to police, Vikram Singh had objected to alleged shouting and nuisance by delivery boys and dhaba staff opposite his house. When he came downstairs to object, he was allegedly attacked with fists and blows.Vikram was taken to Holy Family Hospital by his son Yaiphaba for treatment, where he later succumbed to his injuries.According to the Police, a PCR call regarding the alleged beating of C Vikram Singh was received at Delhi's Sunlight Colony police station on September 7. Police said the preliminary enquiry indicated that Singh had objected to alleged shouting and nuisance by delivery boys and dhaba staff in front of his residence in Kilokari Village. When he came downstairs and objected, he was allegedly assaulted with fists and blows.The official further informed that they have registered an FIR under murder provisions and said all the accused, including minors, have been apprehended.Further investigation is still under way.
Article Summary: Union minister Kiren Rijiju slammed Lok Sabha leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi for "politicising" the killing of Manipuri musician C Vikram Singh in Delhi. The 54-year-old Manipuri music teacher allegedly died after being assaulted by a group of men in Kilokari Village.

Article Title: Delhi HC raps Centre for outing survivor's name in its POSH handbook
Article Text:

Handbook is ‘everywhere and anywhere’ on internet: Lawyer

NEW DELHI: Delhi HC rapped Centre for naming a workplace sexual harassment survivor in a handbook it published on preventing such harassment and dealing with complaints.“How is the name of the victim disclosed in this? How can you do that? You are the govt of India. You yourself are publishing (handbooks) revealing the name of the victim and you are circulating it. It is on your official website,” Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma said, listing the matter for the next hearing on Wednesday.Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) handbook was published by Ministry of Women and Child Development. Law prohibits revealing the identity of the survivor of a sexual offence, and doing so is a punishable offence.HC asked Union govt’s lawyer to come back with the names of officials “responsible for this content” while hearing a petition by the alleged perpetrator, who submitted that the matter has since been settled and therefore, sought directions for removal of his name from the handbook.The petitioner’s counsel submitted that a labour tribunal order arising from the alleged incident has been included in the handbook as an anecdote, revealing the details of not only his identity but the woman’s name as well.The handbook is “everywhere and anywhere” on the internet, the lawyer said. that the Centre’s counsel submitted that the handbook was published in Nov 2015 for educational purposes, and the parties settled the matter only recently.“So will it reveal the name of the victim? Even a judgement cannot,” Justice Sharma responded. “For educational purposes you don’t need the victim’s name, right? Even the judges write ‘X’. There are directions of high court. You can’t disclose the name. Now it is punishable,”HC reminded the counsel as it added that judicial directions to protect a survivor’s identity were in place even before 2015 and the authorities cannot be absolved of their responsibility to follow the law even if a party was acting on it now. The petitioner also sought directions to Google for de-linking and de-indexing the content.
Article Summary: Delhi HC rapped Centre for naming a workplace sexual harassment survivor in a handbook it published. Law prohibits revealing the identity of the survivor of a sexual offence, and doing so is a punishable offence.HC asked Union govt’s lawyer to come back with the names of officials “responsible for this content”

Article Title: BJP demands Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann's resignation over farmer's suicide
Article Text:
BJP demands Punjab CM’s resignation over farmer’s suicide

NEW DELHI: BJP alleged Tuesday that AAP was like a "thug gang" and demanded the resignation of CM Bhagwant Mann after a man died by suicide, allegedly following pressure from AAP functionaries to apologise for questioning minister Harpal Singh Cheema over the drug menace in his village.BJP played a video of Gulzar Singh, a man belonging to a Scheduled Caste who consumed pesticide, narrating the incident and the pressure brought to bear on him after he raised the drug issue during an event attended by Cheema. Singh said his son was addicted to drugs. "After the minister left, an AAP neta, who is the sarpanch of the village, visited Gulzar Singh's home and asked him to apologise to the minister for his remarks," BJP spokesperson Gaurav Bhatia said.Before his death at a hospital, Singh named those who allegedly threatened him, Bhatia said, alleging, "Protector has turned predator", and demanding Mann's resignation.
Article Summary: BJP alleges that AAP was like a "thug gang" and demanded the resignation of Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann. A man died by suicide, allegedly following pressure from AAP functionaries to apologise for questioning minister Harpal Singh Cheema over the drug menace in his village.

Article Title: Expelled Bihar Congress functionaries protest outside party office, seek meeting with Rahul
Article Text:
Expelled Bihar Congress functionaries protest outside party office, seek Rahul Gandhi meeting over state unit issues.

NEW DELHI: A group of expelled Bihar Congress functionaries Tuesday protested in front of the party office here, and demanded a meeting with Rahul Gandhi so that they could “apprise” him of the realities of the state unit.The former Congress functionaries, led by Anand Madhab, were expelled for “anti-party activities” after Bihar assembly elections. They had alleged irregularities in the selection of candidates and blamed AICC in-charge Krishna Allavaru and Bihar Congress chief Rajesh Kumar.Madhab said their demands include an immediate appointment with Rahul, withdrawal of all disciplinary and expulsion proceedings and orders against them. He also demanded removal of Allavaru and Kumar from their posts. Madhab said the process of restoration of faith in the party would start with the fulfilment of their demands. He said the leaders charged with indiscipline should be restored to their earlier positions in the organisation.Madhab said he and colleagues had been demanding a meeting with Rahul for a while, and decided to come to the capital after their demands and concerns were not heard. He said the group protesting is not a dissident bloc but comprises dedicated Congress workers. “We have come to our own house, to meet our guardians and apprise them of the goings on in Bihar Congress,” he said.The protesters included former MLAs Anil Singh, Chhatrapati Yadav, Poonam Devi, and former Bihar Pradesh Congress vice-president Jamal Ahmed, Nagendra paswan.

Expelled functionaries were expelled for “anti-party activities” after Bihar assembly elections. Article Title: 2 BRS MLCs arrested over derogatory remarks against Telangana Speaker
Article Text:
Telangana Assembly Speaker Gaddam Prasad Kumar





HYDERABAD: Two Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) MLCs were arrested by police for allegedly making derogatory remarks against Telangana Assembly Speaker Gaddam Prasad Kumar.On Monday, Pollepalli Venkatesham, OSD to the Telangana Assembly Speaker, lodged a complaint with Saifabad police alleging that BRS MLCs Tata Madhusudhan alias Madhu and N Naveen Kumar had used derogatory language against the Speaker, who belongs to the Scheduled Caste community.The incident took place in front of the Assembly when BRS legislators tried to enter the Assembly premises wearing black shirts in protest against the alleged failure of the state government to fulfil its promises.When police stopped the two MLCs along with other leaders, they allegedly made offensive remarks. The complainant alleged, “T Madhusudhan and N Naveen Kumar Reddy launched a malicious verbal tirade targeting the Speaker, having knowledge that the Speaker hails from a Scheduled Caste community. They used derogatory language against the Speaker on account of his social background and constitutional role in place of public view. They acted with malice to demean the Speaker, incite hatred and cause public disorder.”Based on the complaint, a case was registered against the two MLCs under Section 352 (intentional insult with intent to provoke a breach of the peace), read with Section 3(5) (common intention) of the BNS and the SC/ST (POA) Act on Monday night.Both MLCs were arrested from their houses in Hyderabad on Tuesday. They will be produced before the court for remand.
Article Summary: Two Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) MLCs were arrested by police for allegedly making derogatory remarks against Telangana Assembly Speaker Gaddam Prasad Kumar. The incident took place in front of the Assembly when BRS legislators tried to enter the Assembly premises wearing black shirts.

Article Title: After Satya Niketan PG collapse, CM Rekha Gupta orders bulldozer action across Delhi
Article Text:
Delhi CM Rekha Gupta directs the MCD to use bulldozers against illegal structures.





NEW DELHI: Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta on Wednesday directed the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) to take action against illegal structures, with inspections and demolition drives planned in several parts of the capital.Senior municipal corporation officials have been instructed to remain on the ground as the civic body carries out the action.Gupta also ordered inspections of paying guest (PG) accommodations across Delhi, directing officials to check for unauthorised construction and examine building records."Conduct intensive inspections of all PG hostels in Delhi and take action against illegal construction. Scrutinise building records, determine exactly when the illegal construction took place, and under whose jurisdiction."The directive comes days after a PG building known as 'Hostel Daze' collapsed in Satya Niketan, killing seven people and raising concerns about the safety of accommodation used by students in the area.The building collapsed at around 1pm on Sunday. Police received information about the incident at 1.34pm.The structure, which had a ground floor and four upper floors, housed several students and other residents.According to the FIR, a local inquiry found that the building was over 30 years old and that additional floors had allegedly been constructed to generate rental income.
Article Summary: Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta orders MCD to take action against illegal structures. Inspections and demolition drives planned in several parts of the capital. Gupta also orders inspections of paying guest (PG) accommodations across Delhi. directive comes days after a PG building known as 'Hostel Daze' collapsed in Satya Niketan.

Article Title: Cracks within Sena? MLA accuses minister of shielding corrupt official
Article Text:
Gulabrao Patil

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

:

TOI





A war of words has erupted within Shiv Sena over alleged corruption in Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM), with Paithan MLA Vilas Bhumre accusing water supply and sanitation minister Gulabrao Patil of protecting a tainted executive engineer. Patil said the official in question had already been suspended.Bhumre alleged that several complaints regarding substandard and incomplete JJM works in Paithan taluka went unaddressed despite an inquiry reportedly finding the official guilty. “JJM has been ruined in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar because of one corrupt executive engineer. Despite an inquiry establishing wrongdoing, no action was taken. It is beyond comprehension why the minister is shielding a corrupt official,” he said.The MLA warned that he would take up the issue with party chief and deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde , and CM Devendra Fadnavis , if needed. Rejecting suggestions of factional infighting, Bhumre said his demand was solely for action against those responsible for irregularities in the scheme.His father, Shiv Sena MP Sandipan Bhumre, also called for strict action against allegedly corrupt officials and contractors linked to JJM works.Responding to the allegations, Patil said the executive engineer in question had already been suspended. “There was no recent communication with Bhumre, so he may not be aware of the action taken. Due process has to be followed against any govt servant, and that takes time,” the minister toldBhumre, who has repeatedly raised the issue in the state legislature, has threatened to lead a protest march to Patil’s official residence during the upcoming assembly session. Patil, meanwhile, said officials would be directed to ensure effective implementation of JJM in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.In Dec 2025, Patil had admitted in the assembly that irregularities were detected in 73 JJM works in the district after concerns were raised by Bhumre and two other MLAs.
Article Summary: Paithan MLA Vilas Bhumre accuses water supply and sanitation minister Gulabrao Patil of protecting a tainted executive engineer. Patil said the official in question had already been suspended. He admitted in the assembly that irregularities were detected in 73 JJM works in the district.

Article Title: Quack doctor detained in Maharashtra for practising medicine without registration
Article Text:
A 27-year-old quack doctor was detained by Panvel police after an inspection (Representative image)





NAVI MUMBAI: A 27-year-old quack doctor was detained by Panvel taluka police after a complaint was lodged by the medical officer of the Primary Health Centre at Ajivali village in Panvel taluka, following an inspection by health department officials at his illegal clinic in Kasalkhand village on Monday afternoon.The accused was identified as Noorul Huda Imamul Haq, who hails from West Bengal and resides in an MHADA building in India Bulls Township, Kon village, Panvel.Gajanan Ghadge, senior inspector of Panvel taluka police, informed that the complaint was lodged by medical officer Dr Sayali Mankar, 33, who inspected Haq's clinic in Kasalkhand village and found that he was an unqualified and unregistered medical practitioner allegedly practising modern medicine by posing as a doctor.He had been running the clinic and treating patients for the past one month, police said. The police seized medicines stocked at the clinic as evidence.Inspector Ghadge said, "We have invoked relevant sections of the Maharashtra Medical Practitioners Act, 1961, against the accused, which prohibit any person from practising medicine in the state unless their name is registered under the relevant statutory provisions and prescribe criminal penalties and fines for those who illegally practise medicine without valid registration. Under the law, the accused was served a notice under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), directing him to appear for inquiry when summoned and during the court proceedings. "
Article Summary: The accused was identified as Noorul Huda Imamul Haq, who hails from West Bengal. He had been running the clinic and treating patients for the past one month, police said. The police seized medicines stocked at the clinic as evidence.

Article Title: 'Grabbed hand and attempted to disrobe': Cab driver tries to assault woman passenger near Navi Mumbai airport
Article Text:
Police have registered a case and are searching for the accused driver (Representative image)





NAVI MUMBAI: A woman passenger travelling home after attending a party in Chembur allegedly faced molestation and an attempted assault by a cab driver who took the vehicle to a deserted road near Navi Mumbai airport late on Saturday night, police said on Sunday.The incident took place around 1.30am on the airport service road, about two kilometres from Navi Mumbai airport, police said. The accused allegedly stopped the cab on the pretext of drinking water before moving to the rear seat beside the woman, police said.According to the police, the woman was travelling to Panvel after a friend booked a cab for her following the party."The driver stopped the vehicle on the deserted service road, stepped out briefly, and then re-entered the car, sitting on the rear seat next to the woman. He allegedly grabbed her hand and attempted to disrobe her," said an official of the Navi Mumbai Police.The woman managed to break free and escape from the vehicle, following which the driver allegedly fled the spot.After the incident, the woman contacted her family and went to Panvel Police Station to lodge a complaint.Since the alleged incident took place within the jurisdiction of Navi Mumbai airport police station, Panvel police escorted her to the appropriate police station.Based on her complaint, Navi Mumbai Airport Police registered a case against the accused, identified as Mohammad Afzal Shaikh, under relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).Police have launched a search for Shaikh and are using technical intelligence to trace his whereabouts.Further investigation is underway.(With ANI inputs)(The victim's identity has not been revealed to protect her privacy as per Supreme court directives on cases related to sexual assault)
Article Summary: A woman passenger travelling home after attending a party in Chembur allegedly faced molestation and an attempted assault by a cab driver. The incident took place around 1.30am on the airport service road, about two kilometres from Navi Mumbai airport. The woman managed to break free and escape from the vehicle, following which the driver allegedly fled the spot.

Article Title: FIR lodged after 3,400 SIR forms found in Navi Mumbai shop; 5 BLOs suspended
Article Text:
An FIR was registered against Suraj Patil for illegally possessing voter enumeration forms





NAVI MUMBAI: The police have registered an FIR against Suraj Patil, a nodal BJP youth wing committee member, for illegally possessing and converting special intensive revision (SIR) voter enumeration forms for “personal use” and for breaking the maintenance of secrecy of voting under Section 314 of the BNS and Section 128 of the Representation of People Act.Section 314 of the BNS deals with dishonestly converting a movable property for own use, for which the punishment is at least two years imprisonment.The matter came to light on Thursday, after an advocate working for the Shiv Sena (UBT) noticed hundreds of original SIR forms lying at a photocopier’s shop in Kharghar. He alerted the police.The accused (Patil) had decamped from the Kharghar police station, leading to high drama throughout the night.Authorities seized 3,404 SIR forms, including 11 blank ones, of 11 polling stations from the photocopier’s shop next to the Ramsheth Thakur Public School in Sector 19, Kharghar, by Shiv Sena (UBT) nodal chief Balesh Bhojane.Five booth-level officers (BLOs) served with show-cause notices were suspended by the Panvel City Municipal Corporation (PCMC) chief Mangesh Chitale.They include three data entry operators working as booth-level officers from a private company, Saunik Integrated & Security Pvt Ltd, Bhayandar, engaged by the PCMC.Their names are Sulochana Mane, Prashant Mhatre and Rahul Bhagat.The Shiv Sena (UBT) had earlier warned the Panvel sub-divisional officer through a letter about various lapses in the electoral process.A two-member inquiry committee comprising a Panvel deputy municipal commissioner, Nanasaheb Kamathe, and an assistant electoral registration officer, has been formed to conduct a comprehensive probe.Bhojane said, “MLAs Jitendra Awhad and Rohit Pawar have tweeted the video regarding the original SIR forms at the Kharghar shop. We demand action against the Panvel SDO as he did not take preventive measures despite our complaint about forms filed at the BJP offices. The FIR was filed only after more than hundreds of our workers assembled at the police station.”After learning about the incident, Raigad district communication head of Shiv Sena (UBT) Prasad Bhoir lodged a complaint with the electoral registration officer.“Yesterday evening, the election registration office (ERO) received information that a person is xeroxing enumeration forms at a Xerox centre at Kharghar sector 19. Immediately, the assistant election registration officer visited the site and found that one Suraj Patil was holding around 3,400 enumeration forms and xeroxing it illegally,” Raigad district collector Kishan Javale said.
Article Summary: Police have registered an FIR against Suraj Patil, a nodal BJP youth wing committee member, for illegally possessing and converting voter enumeration forms. The matter came to light on Thursday, after an advocate working for the Shiv Sena (UBT) noticed hundreds of original SIR forms lying at a photocopier’s shop in Kharghar.

Article Title: Shiv Sena leader Rahul Gharat arrested in Palghar hospital doctor assault case
Article Text:
A Shiv Sena leader was arrested after a hospital ruckus involving injured Govindas

MLA seeks action against doctors





PALGHAR: Shiv Sena (Shinde faction) Palghar city chief Rahul Gharat, the main accused in the alleged ruckus and assault at a private hospital in Palghar, was arrested on Monday after he surrendered before the police.The incident took place at Relief Hospital in Palghar on Saturday night when five injured Govindas, who had sustained injuries during Dahi Handi celebrations, were admitted for treatment. Three of them were kept in the intensive care unit (ICU).The injured Govindas had alleged that the hospital was forcing them to undergo CT scans and was trying to charge them excessive amounts. Following the allegations, Shiv Sena office-bearers and workers entered the hospital late at night and allegedly created a ruckus. A hospital employee was assaulted and the IV lines of the Govindas admitted to the ICU were allegedly removed before they were taken away.Palghar police had registered a case against 17 people, including Shiv Sena district chief Kundan Sankhe, city chief Rahul Gharat, the son of MLA Rajendra Gavit and deputy taluka chief Rohit Gavit, under various sections of the law.“Gharat appeared before the Palghar police station on Monday and was arrested.Efforts are on to trace the remaining accused,” said Kishor Manbhav, senior police inspector of Palghar police station.Meanwhile, injured Govinda Akash Patil reiterated his allegations against the doctors. He claimed that although he felt better after being given an injection, he was allegedly kept in the ICU for three hours after being put on a saline drip against his wishes. He demanded action against the doctors.Palghar MLA Rajendra Gavit visited the Palghar police station on Monday and demanded that a case be registered against the doctors.Gavit alleged that the hospital staff were forcing the injured Govindas to stay back and undergo MRI and CT scans. He said Shiv Sena workers had gone to the hospital to help the injured Govindas and that a verbal altercation had taken place.He alleged that the doctors had filed a complaint against the Shiv Sena workers out of vendetta and pressured the police to register a case. “Can a patient not even question a doctor about an excessive bill?” Gavit asked, demanding that the police register a case against the doctors.
Article Summary: Palghar city chief Rahul Gharat, the main accused in the alleged ruckus and assault at a private hospital in Palghar, was arrested on Monday. The incident took place at Relief Hospital on Saturday night when five injured Govindas, who had sustained injuries during Dahi Handi celebrations, were admitted for treatment. Three of them were kept in the intensive care unit.

Article Title: 'Minor injuries, kept in ICU': Govinda group file FIR against Palghar doctor, threaten sit-in outside police station
Article Text:
Sena’s district chief Kundan Sankhe claimed they went to Relief Hospital after receiving complaints that the govindas were not being allowed to leave





PALGHAR: A fresh twist has emerged in the alleged assault of a receptionist at Relief Hospital in Palghar, with the injured Govinda participants whose treatment triggered the dispute filing a written complaint against the doctor at Palghar police station.A case has already been registered against 17 people, including Shiv Sena district chief Kundan Sankhe, in connection with the alleged assault.In their complaint, the Govinda participants alleged that although they had suffered only minor injuries, they were deliberately kept in the ICU and were not discharged despite repeatedly requesting the doctor to release them.They further alleged that the doctor ignored their requests, following which they sought the intervention of Sankhe. The participants claimed that unnecessary treatment was continued despite there being no medical requirement for it.The complainants have demanded that a case be registered against the doctor over the alleged conduct.Palghar MLA Rajendra Gavit, along with senior Shiv Sena functionaries, party workers and members of the Govinda group, gathered outside Palghar police station in support of the complaint.Gavit warned that the group would stage a sit-in outside the police station until a case was registered against the doctor.The latest complaint comes amid the ongoing controversy over the alleged assault of the hospital receptionist and the case registered against Sankhe and others.
Article Summary: Govinda participants claim they were deliberately kept in the ICU and were not discharged despite repeatedly requesting the doctor to release them. A case has already been registered against 17 people, including Shiv Sena district chief Kundan Sankhe, in connection with the alleged assault.

Article Title: Nandurbar police seize ganja worth Rs2.2cr, one held
Article Text:
Nashik:





The local crime branch (LCB) of Nandurbar police seized 443 kg of illegally cultivated ganja valued at Rs2.2 crore in Ghatli village under the jurisdiction of Dhadgaon police station.The police have arrested one person from the spot, while another accused managed to flee. Acting on the directives from Nandurbar superintendent of police Ashwini Sanap to curb illegal drugs, weapons and liquor trafficking, LCB inspector Hemant Patil received confidential information on Monday that cannabis was being secretly cultivated at a farm in Ghatli village.Subsequently, Patil, under the guidance of senior officers, immediately dispatched a team to raid the specified location. Upon searching the farm, the team discovered full-grown cannabis plants illegally intercropped between other crops.The arrested accused has been identified as Shailesh Shankar Pawara, a resident of Ghatli village, Dhadgaon. Patil said that the accused were growing the cannabis over a huge area. “The process of uprooting the cannabis plants continued till 11pm,” he said.A case has been registered against both the accused under the relevant sections of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985.
Article Summary: The local crime branch (LCB) of Nandurbar police seized 443 kg of illegally cultivated ganja valued at Rs2.2 crore in Ghatli village under the jurisdiction of Dhadgaon police station. The police have arrested one person from the spot, while another accused managed to flee.

Article Title: TN assembly urges Centre to scrap ‘open column’ method in 2027 caste census
Article Text:
Calls for standardised list

Chennai:





TNNTamil Nadu Legislative Assembly on Tuesday adopted a resolution urging Union govt to scrap the “open column” method for recording caste details in the upcoming Census and instead provide a pre-loaded, standardised list of officially notified castes.The resolution has been passed days after former chief minister M K Stalin demanded that the assembly adopt such a resolution to protect the rights of OBCs. However, DMK members were not present when the resolution was tabled as they were evicted from the House. The resolution was adopted unanimously by the members of AIADMK, PMK, VCK, Congress and BJP who were present.Moving the resolution, backward classes welfare minister V Sampath Kumar, urged that a drop-down list of castes notified by state and union govts should be provided for the public to choose from during phase 2 of the 2027 Census. It said the open-entry method, which allows individuals to manually enter caste names, could lead to ambiguity and affect the quality and usability of data.Participating in the debate, former minister and AIADMK MLA C Ve Shanmugam cited the experience of the 2011 Socio-Economic and Caste Census and warned that repeating the open-entry exercise would create administrative chaos.He said official enumerations before 1931 had recorded around 4,147 caste names across the country.However, when the 2011 exercise allowed open-ended self-reporting, the number of caste names grew to 46.7 lakh.“If the open column method is followed in the census, the number of caste names could easily cross one crore,” Shanmugam said.Shanmugam also cautioned against attempts to blur the distinction between caste and class in official documentation. He pointed out that Other Backward Classes represented a social category comprising several individual communities and could not be treated as a single caste. In Tamil Nadu alone, he said, 262 communities were covered under the OBC category.PMK MLA Ganeshkumar echoed similar concerns and backed the demand for a standardised list.
Article Summary: Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly urges Union govt to scrap the ‘open column’ method for recording caste details in the upcoming Census. The resolution was adopted unanimously by the members of AIADMK, PMK, VCK, Congress and BJP who were present.

Article Title: Dalit girl suicide: Family seeks protection, HM yet to be arrested
Article Text:

Two weeks after a 16-year-old dalit student died by suicide following an admission dispute at a Usilampatti school, her family has alleged intimidation from members of kallar community and sought police protection.“I request justice, compensation and protection for our family,” girl’s mother P Thavamani, 40, said in a petition submitted to the Madurai collector.The girl, Nishanthi , had scored 412 out of 500 in Class X and hoped to pursue nursing. On Aug 24, she lowered her mother’s folded hands when they approached Govt Higher Secondary School near Usilampatti bus stand for admission. TOI reported on Aug 28 that relatives accused police of refusing to invoke the SC/ST Act despite their complaint alleging caste discrimination. Police later altered the FIR to add Section 108 of BNS and Section 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.Thavamani said the family had not received compensation and urged authorities to dismiss Vimaladevi, who has been suspended by the school education department.Her petition also sought an immediate arrest of Vimaladevi, a chargesheet within two months, an expedited trial and protection for her family members.Meanwhile, Vimaladevi moved the Madurai bench of Madras high court while apprehending arrest. Article Title: BJP’s Shone George demands Pinarayi Vijayan’s resignation over ED’s FIR request
Article Text:

Kottayam

BJP state vice-president Shone George has called for the resignation of leader of opposition Pinarayi Vijayan , in the wake of the enforcement directorate (ED) reportedly asking the state DGP to register an FIR against him under Prevention of Corruption Act in the CMRL pay-off case.George said LDF should convene a meeting and remove Vijayan from his post, adding that the front should seek his resignation as MLA as well. He alleged that if Vijayan continues to hold the post, CPM as a party would itself cease to exist, and alleged that Vijayan was the accused in the case.George alleged that money had been received through a company owned by Vijayan’s daughter Veena T as a reward for allegedly permitting illegal exploitation of Keralam’s coastal areas. He demanded that Kerala Police immediately register an FIR and begin an investigation into the matter.George’s remarks come on the heels of ED’s move to request the DGP’s action in the case — a case in which George himself had filed the original complaint.
Article Summary: BJP state vice-president Shone George has called for the resignation of leader of opposition Pinarayi Vijayan. George said LDF should convene a meeting and remove Vijayan from his post, adding that the front should seek his resignation as MLA as well.

Article Title: Hand over Messi event probe to central agencies, says Kerala BJP’s Shone George
Article Text:
BJP state vice-president Shone George

Kottayam

:





BJP state vice-president Shone George has lodged a formal complaint with central agencies seeking a thorough investigation into alleged financial fraud and regulatory violations related to the proposed visit by Argentina football legend Lionel Messi to Keralam.The complaint chiefly seeks a probe into moves made under the pretext of bringing Messi to Kerala , and the financial dealings allegedly conducted. It also urges central agencies to examine the funding sources and transactions linked to the matter.George alleged that Messi’s name was used as a front to route money abroad, and said the alleged fraud should largely be probed by central agencies such as Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO).He called on the chief minister to hand over the investigation to central agencies and said there were grounds to suspect that the special investigation team formed by state govt was a calculated move to shield the accused.

He is seeking a thorough investigation into alleged financial fraud and regulatory violations related to the proposed visit by Argentina football legend Lionel Messi to Keralam. Article Title: Activist seeks action on derogatory remarks against Sabarimala deities
Article Text:
Rahul K Easwar

Kochi:





Activist Rahul K Easwar has approached the high court seeking a directive to Meta Platforms Inc and other social media intermediaries to take down controversial videos containing alleged remarks by activist Sunny M Kapikad against Lord Ayyappa and Malikappurathamma.A bench of Justice G Gireesh directed the petitioner to take steps to issue notice to the respondents and adjourned the petition to Sept 10. The petitioner’s case was that Kapikad had allegedly made certain controversial remarks against the two deities. According to Easwar, the explicit and vulgar expressions had triggered widespread public outrage. He further stated that the video containing the alleged remarks was widely shared and circulated through social media platforms. He further claimed that despite filing a complaint seeking action, a case had not yet been registered.He sought a directive to the police to act on his complaint and register a case against the respondents. Additionally, he sought directions to the state and the police to take steps to remove the videos from social media platforms.
